summary: Add a LAN-safe client message ID fallback to both chat entry points.
final_report: Implemented a LAN-safe client_msg_id generator in static/index.html and static/sage-workspace.html. Each chat flow now uses crypto.randomUUID when available and falls back to a version 4, variant 1 UUID assembled from crypto.getRandomValues when available plus Math.random and the current time. The existing home send lock still prevents duplicate session creation, and the awaited session creation remains before the turn POST; response streaming, rendering, title refresh, and backend persistence paths are unchanged. No backend files were modified. JSON validation passed, the UUID format smoke check passed, and source inspection confirmed both turn requests use client_msg_id().
notes: Manifest initially declared source files and T5.json; oc-issues.txt was added after two PowerShell filesystem-command failures, per system-error logging policy. Rechecked the declared source files against base_commit; no concurrent changes were detected. Existing home flow sets streaming before session creation, preventing duplicate creation from repeated sends; the turn request remains after the awaited create response.
